summary: I'm a data scientist who moved into generative AI and agentic systems. For nearly three years (2021–2024) I built machine learning in industry: most recently at Retisio, where I developed a Conditional Random Field model that extracts entities from e-commerce search queries and ran model workflows on Google Cloud (Cloud Composer/Airflow, App Engine) in an Agile team.

Since mid-2024 I've specialised in LLM systems. I started with retrieval-augmented question answering and Microsoft AutoGen agent teams, then designed two multi-agent platforms end to end: NexusAI, which routes each request to one of eight tool-using specialist agents behind guardrails and PII redaction, and IntelliHub, which turns one question into a single sourced briefing by running collector agents concurrently.
Today I'm a Data Science Intern working on time-series forecasting, and I'm pursuing Great Learning's Post Graduate Program in Data Science with Generative AI.

journey.title: Engineering roots, data science foundations
journey.body: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering at Lovely Professional University, then a Post Graduate Diploma in Data Science from IIIT Bangalore (2020): statistics, machine learning, deep learning and big-data tooling.

journey.title: First Data Scientist role
journey.body: At AIE Software India I delivered data-science solutions over high-dimensional text and image data — from requirements gathering and gap analysis through modelling and deployment.

journey.title: Search intelligence for e-commerce
journey.body: At Retisio India I built a CRF-based named-entity recognition model for search queries, owned its data-preparation pipeline, analysed product-view and purchase trends for recommendations, and scheduled model workflows on GCP.

journey.title: Retraining toward Generative AI
journey.body: Independent builds to learn the stack properly: RAG question answering over medical-research PDFs, a teachable AutoGen agent that extracts structured metadata, and an AutoGen code-writing and code-executing agent team.

journey.title: Multi-agent platforms
journey.body: Designed and built NexusAI and IntelliHub — orchestration, ReAct tool calling, intent routing with clarification, guardrails, streaming APIs and 571 offline tests between them — and completed Anthropic Academy courses on Claude Code, Agent Skills and Claude with Amazon Bedrock.

journey.title: Forecasting internship, continued study
journey.body: Data Science Intern at Unified Mentor building care-load and placement forecasts, while pursuing the PG Program in Data Science with Generative AI.

approach.title: Deterministic where it matters
approach.body: Rules before models, and code before prose: route with cheap rules first, call an LLM classifier only when needed, and compute every number in Python so figures stay reproducible.

approach.title: Test without the network
approach.body: Deterministic mock LLM clients let routing, guardrail and tool changes be regression-checked locally, without API keys or cost.

approach.title: Fail visibly
approach.body: When a data feed or tool fails, degrade to a clearly labelled partial result instead of a confident wrong answer.

approach.title: Guardrails by design
approach.body: Input and output rails, PII redaction and mandatory disclaimers are pipeline stages, not afterthoughts.

about.goals: Join a team shipping production GenAI — as a Data Scientist, GenAI Engineer or Agentic AI Engineer — where reliability matters as much as capability.
